title: Crediting Date for a Qualifying PAP Compliance Download (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Crediting rule.** When the newest compliance download on a patient's PAP device record (PAP Therapy Equipment) proves continued use for the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the date credited to it is:

1. the **practitioner visit date**, when the newest re-evaluation documenting benefit is dated on the day the download was taken or no more than 7 days before it;
2. when there is no such re-evaluation, the **date the download was taken**, when it was taken no more than 7 days after the last night of its window.

Where neither line applies, no such crediting date applies under this rule.

## Input — judgement — output

| Newest re-evaluation documenting benefit, relative to the day the download was taken | Days from the last night of the window to the day taken | Date credited |
|---|---|---|
| same day, or 1 to 7 days before | any | the practitioner visit date |
| more than 7 days before, after the download, or none | 0 to 7 | the date the download was taken |
| more than 7 days before, after the download, or none | 8 or more | no crediting date under this rule |

Only the newest re-evaluation documenting benefit is compared. A re-evaluation dated after the day the download was taken does not meet line 1.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Window's last night on the 1st, download taken on the 6th, newest re-evaluation documenting benefit dated the 3rd: the re-evaluation is 3 days before the download, so the credited date is the 3rd.
- Same download, newest re-evaluation dated the 20th of the previous month (more than 7 days before): line 2 applies; the download was taken 5 days after its window's last night, so the credited date is the 6th.
- Window's last night on the 1st, download taken on the 15th, no re-evaluation on record: 14 days have passed, neither line applies.
